ja271:1.1: For the seer in the wilds
ja271:1.2: who lives austere for many nights,
ja271:1.3: Dear friend, why did you spoil this well which was made with difficulty?
ja271:2.1: This is the nature of jackals,
ja271:2.3: It is our fathers’ and grandfathers’ nature,
ja271:3.1: Those for whom such is natural,
ja271:3.3: Don’t let me see your natural or unnatural
